import re from typing import List # Compile a regex that matches any HTML tag (opening, closing or self‑closing). _TAG_RE = re.compile(r'<[^>]*>', flags=re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL) def extract_html_tags(html_string: str) -> List[str]: """ Extract all HTML tags from the provided string. Parameters ---------- html_string : str The input HTML content to search for tags. Returns ------- List[str] A list of matched tag strings, e.g. ['
', '']. Returns an empty list if no tags are found or input is not a string. Notes ----- The function never raises an exception; it returns an empty list on any error. """ try: if not isinstance(html_string, str): return [] # Find all non-overlapping matches of the tag pattern. tags = _TAG_RE.findall(html_string) return tags except Exception: # Silently catch all exceptions and return an empty list. return []
